materials.content: Watercolor on moderately thick, cream, smooth wove paperwith a slightly fuzzy feel (Source: Lynes, 1999)

cr_data.provenance: Purchased from Georgia O’Keeffe (Source: Amarillo Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Whitney Mus. May 1946.... Note: probably ptd. about 1915 or 1916." Whitney Archive dates 1915. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1916. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1917. Completed after August move to Texas. O'Keeffe frequently depicted architectural forms shortly after arriving in a new place, a pattern first noted in her work by Lisa Messinger in *Georgia O'Keeffe* (1988). See cat. nos. 122–25, 127. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A deep blue, pitched roof with a few amorphous patches of pink fills the frame. A greenish blue dormer with two dark red windows sticks out from the roof, while two chimneys jut into the gray sky.
title: Roof with Snow
